overview: For years, agriculture has been blamed for the bad Danish aquatic environment. But farmers believe they don't bear the responsibility alone. For each year, large amounts of untreated wastewater are discharged into the same aquatic environment. But who's right? On opposite sides of a highly topical conflict, the farmers and scientists stand: Is agriculture the biggest culprit - or does the wastewater play a bigger role than previously thought?
title: The Ballad of the Dirty Water

data.overview: Landbruget har i årevis fået skylden for det dårlige danske vandmiljø. Men landmændene mener, at de ikke bærer ansvaret alene. For hvert år ledes store mængder urenset spildevand ud i det selv samme vandmiljø. Men hvem har ret? På hver sin side af en højaktuel konflikt står landmændene og forskerne: Er landbruget den største synder - eller spiller spildevandet en større rolle end hidtil antaget?
